_note: A sum qualifying under Income-tax Act, 2025 s.123 — Schedule XV para 1(b): "sum paid under a deferred annuity contract other than the annuity plan referred to in clause (l) on life of the individual, spouse of the individual and any child of the individual, and such contract does not contain an option to receive cash payment in lieu of the annuity" (Gazette 265620, p.561). D-130. No option to receive cash in lieu of the annuity — an entry condition. TY 2025-26: Income-tax Act, 1961 s.80C(2)(ii) (thc p.330): "to effect or to keep in force a contract for a deferred annuity, not being an annuity plan referred to in clause (xii)". sources/2026-10-07-chapter-via.md; D-144.
